Package io.jans.lock.trace.crypto

Class TraceCryptoException

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Throwable
java.lang.Exception
java.lang.RuntimeException
io.jans.lock.trace.crypto.TraceCryptoException
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class TraceCryptoException extends RuntimeException
Thrown by the TRACE crypto layer when a key cannot be built from a JWK or when the security provider cannot perform Ed25519 operations. Also thrown by TraceCryptoProvider for a signature that does not verify, for input that cannot be canonicalized and for input that cannot be a receipt position. Messages never carry key material, signature bytes or record content.

The reason is a short stable token intended for the structured error body (reason member); the message is for logs.

Author:
Yuriy Movchan
